name: Hakudaku Kissa Kanban Musume
source:
In a certain city, at a certain cafe, the waitresses are tasked with attracting customers. Unfortunately, some less-than-savory men have set their eyes on one particular girl... and they don't take no for an answer.

Abducted and taken to a ruined building on the edge of town, she wakes up to find herself surrounded by... a group of men, pants down, and ready to r*pe.

"I can't believe this will be my first time... no... don't let it be so... stop it... get away from me...!"

Unable to resist, she is thoroughly and mercilessly violated... and her friends end up being abducted too.
But this... is only the beginning of her grueling ordeal...

[From DLsite English]
translation:
在某个城市，在某个咖啡馆，女服务员的任务就是吸引顾客。不幸的是，一些不太有品味的男人把目光投向了一个特定的女孩……而且他们不接受拒绝。

她被绑架并带到城镇边缘的一座废墟建筑中，醒来后发现自己被一群男人包围，他们脱下裤子，准备强奸。

“我不敢相信这会是我的第一次……不……不要这样……停下来……离我远点……！”

她无力反抗，遭到彻底无情的侵犯……而她的朋友们也被绑架。
但这……只是她痛苦磨难的开始……

[来自DLsite英文]
